protocols.title: Matrixyl 3000 Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Topical cosmetic blend (palmitoyl tripeptide-1 + palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7), formulated around 3–10% in finished serum and applied to clean skin. No injectable or oral dosing; evidence modest and largely manufacturer-led.
